articles.title: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
articles.description: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.
articles.summary: Some young people could see reductions to the benefits they are entitled to, under a radical overhaul of the system to be recommended by a government-commissioned review.
key_points: Alan Milburn's year-long report, which will be published on Tuesday, will recommend moving under-25s off the main sickness and disability benefits, the Times reported , external .
Milburn, a former Labour health secretary, has been tasked by the government with helping reduce the one in eight 18- to 24-year-olds in the UK who are not in education, employment or training…
He said on Wednesday night that his plans would not be "pain-free" and would affect both existing and new claimants.

articles.title: The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal
articles.description: Within days, Huang's status as a seemingly untouchable figure leading the global tech race has crumbled.
articles.summary: Jensen Huang, known for sporting a black leather jacket to shareholder events, appeared to have it all.
key_points: He was courted by leaders in both Washington and Beijing, worshipped by investors and seen as a loyal family man.
But a rockstar approach to his personal life has ultimately led to his resignation.
The 63-year-old has been married since 1985, long before the foundation of Nvidia, the company that propelled him to tech stardom.

articles.title: Poundland gets more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
articles.description: A deadline to secure a buyer was set to expire at midnight, but the retailer now has an extra 10 days to find a buyer.
articles.summary: Poundland has avoided immediate collapse after a deadline was extended to find a rescue deal.
key_points: A deadline to secure a buyer for the retail chain was set to expire at midnight, but a court has given Poundland an extra 10 days to find a buyer.
The discount chain, which has 11,000 employees, has been edging towards administration after being blocked by owners Gordon Brothers from accessing cash in its bank accounts.
A committee of MPs questioned Gordon Brothers following accusations that the investment firm hoped to profit from selling off Poundland's 600 shops and stock piecemeal.

articles.title: Faisal Islam: Why the UK economy is surprisingly resilient
articles.description: The UK is seeing impressive growth, but will it last?
articles.summary: The UK economy grew at its fastest rate for more than two years in the three months to September.
key_points: "Top gear" and "strikingly strong" were among the descriptions of the 0.7% growth offered by the economists who track every minor murmur of Britain's economy.
It is an upgrade on "solid" and "resilient", and in turn a world away from "hardest hit by the Iran War".
Against the backdrop of the world's biggest disruption to energy flows, rising market borrowing costs - and the cruel summers since the pandemic - it is impressive growth.

articles.description: ﻿The UK economy grew by 0.7% in the three months to September, according to official figures.
